cities.request: Au milieu, un vrai palais ou chateau sous forme de laboratoire a plantes.
cities.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image 1 is the EXACT CURRENT ARBORIUM 10 EDIT TARGET. Keep this image and its immense forest-sized dome. Make ONE targeted architectural change INSIDE THE DOME AT THE MIDDLE: a genuine impressive PALACE / CASTLE THAT IS A BOTANICAL RESEARCH LABORATORY, replacing and consolidating the existing little central civic spires. No text, borders, labels or interface.
PRESERVE: colossal dome and its silhouette, glass and copper/living-wood ribs, foundations, tiny outer entrance, camera, 16:9 framing, sunlight, outside landscape, internal forests, coherent residential neighborhoods and waterways. Do not shrink the dome or enlarge the houses. Maintain the tactile Kalistar fantasy painting, green/gold/pearl palette and soft natural atmosphere, no CGI.
CENTRAL LANDMARK: In the middle of the enclosed forest city, behind the foreground dome ribs and above the central inner riverbank, create ONE complete legible PALACE-LABORATORY. It should read as a real regal inhabited building with coherent connected wings, NOT a handful of scattered ornamental spires. Broad pale weathered stone and elegant living-wood architecture, a substantial central hall with a graceful glass conservatory roof, two lower connected research wings, a few restrained slender lookout turrets, coherent foundations on a dry wooded terrace. Castle-like stature and dignified massing, with a clearly recognizable main entrance and a central courtyard at miniature human scale. Physically connected walkways lead from the existing residential paths into the palace; do not block or reroute the river or make it float on the water.
PLANT LAB IDENTITY: Beautiful long vaulted glass research galleries in the side wings, ordered planted experimental beds in the inner courtyards, terraced botanical gardens and attached glasshouses with green foliage visible through their glazing. A unified royal academy of plants, not a factory, sci-fi laboratory, suburban greenhouse collection or ordinary Gothic cathedral. Use botanical structural curves and sophisticated craft rather than a carpet of leaves stuck to every wall. Small doors, windows and floor heights all consistent with the normal houses nearby.
SCALE HIERARCHY: The palace is clearly the main city building, larger and more substantial than a residential cluster, and immediately readable at this panoramic distance. It occupies only a modest portion of the vast interior, with generous trees and gardens around it. The dome remains OVERWHELMINGLY larger: the palace roof stays far below the shell, and the wide forest canopy remains dominant. No giant tower reaching the dome, no second bubble or dome covering the palace. Keep the shell's foreground ribs and reflections correctly in front of the palace.
COHERENCE OVER FILLER: Individual connected volumes, believable roof spans and support, selective detail at this distance; no repetitive arches, infinitely repeated towers or copy-pasted tiny buildings. Preserve quiet forest between the central palace and the existing residential neighborhoods. The change should be ONE BEAUTIFUL BOTANICAL PALACE AT THE CENTER OF THE SAME CITY, not a total regeneration or crowded collage.
